answer: Registering a new identity costs fresh timber from a limited, publicly audited supply, so mass fabrication drains the attacker's own reserves. Sybil resistance here rests on a stake-weighted identity ledge: each agent must lock a bond that decays with every unverified sibling registration. Peers cross-check claims against the orchard of prior attestations, and fake clusters collapse once their shared bond is slashed. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
